featureUsage.title: Feature usage
featureUsage.description: How the features of Artemis were used in the selected period, grouped into product areas the way users know them. Counts come from the server itself, are aggregated per day and contain nothing about individual users. Features nobody used are listed too, because those are the ones worth a decision.
featureUsage.limitations: The role is the caller's highest role in any course, not their role in the course the call touched. Git and background features have no caller and count as anonymous. WebSocket traffic is not counted, so features that mostly communicate over the websocket appear less used than they are.

legend.action: the user did something, such as submitting, creating or generating
legend.view: the user looked at something the feature shows
legend.automatic: the page called the server on its own, such as a status check or a badge; not counted as use
legend.system: another system called the server, such as a build agent or an AI service reporting back; not counted as use

kpi.onlyAutomaticDetail: called by pages or other systems, but nobody used them
kpi.unusedDetail: offered, but not a single call
kpi.noActionsDetail: looked at, but never acted on
kpi.usesDetail: {{ actions }} actions, {{ views }} views, {{ automatic }} automatic and {{ system }} system calls

onlyAutomatic.title: Only automatic or system calls
onlyAutomatic.hint: The server hears from these features because pages people open call them on their own, or because another system does, but nobody used them. Counted by calls alone, they looked like the busiest features.

unused.title: Unused
unused.hint: Offered in this deployment, but not a single call in the period.

noActions.title: Viewed, no actions
noActions.hint: People look at what these features show, but never take the step they exist for. For a feature people mostly read this can be fine; for an authoring aid it usually is not.

featureUsage.noActionsHint: The feature has endpoints that act, and none of them was called in this period.
featureUsage.search: Search features, modules, resources or paths
featureUsage.roleDistribution: Actions and views per caller role
featureUsage.noUsageYet: No action or view has been recorded in this period yet. Counters are written every few minutes, so a freshly started server shows nothing at first.
featureUsage.digestSent: The weekly feature usage email was sent.
featureUsage.digestFailed: The weekly feature usage email could not be sent. Check that the digest is enabled and a recipient is configured.
